# Locale `en-GB`

Unit names were seeded from CLDR 48.2.3.

## Plural rules

| Category | Condition |
|---|---|
| one | `i = 1 and v = 0` |
| other | *everything else* |

## Units

The identifier resolves in every locale and is what a conversion writes
when the locale has no symbol. So do `℃`, `℉`, `ºC`, `ºF` and the
bare `C` and `F`, whatever the locale names. The bare letters are safe
only because lookup is case-sensitive: `c` is a cup in `en`, `en-001`,
`en-AU` and `en-GB`. Long forms are CLDR patterns by plural category,
with `{0}` where the number goes.

## Units chosen for the reader

Region `GB`, whose official system is **Metric**.

### Preference rows

Largest first; a value is shown in the first unit it reaches the
threshold of, falling back to the last. A region's own rows override
its system's for that quantity; time is the same everywhere.

| Quantity | From | Order |
|---|---|---|
| Volume | Metric | `liter` ≥ 1 → `milliliter` ≥ 50 → `metric tablespoon` ≥ 1 (/2) → `metric teaspoon` ≥ 0.25 (/4) → `milliliter` ≥ 0 |
| Mass | Metric | `kilogram` ≥ 1 → `gram` ≥ 1 → `milligram` ≥ 1 |
| Length | Metric | `meter` ≥ 1 → `centimeter` ≥ 1 → `millimeter` ≥ 1 |
| Temperature | Metric | `celsius` ≥ 1 |
| Time | shared | `day` ≥ 1 → `hour` ≥ 1 → `minute` ≥ 1 → `second` ≥ 1 |
